correction: An earlier version of this file reported the missing -ca listings as unexplained erosion. That was wrong. The owner removed them deliberately, acting on the recommendation recorded in reports/elderemo-canada-builds.json: where a Global Fulfillment -int listing already serves Canada at $6.79, a Canada-only listing on Print Geek at $7.09 is redundant and narrower. The question worth asking was never "who did this" but "did it go further than intended".
answer: It went further than intended. Of 143 -ca listings no longer active, 87 are correctly covered by a live -int listing. The other 56 have no -int twin anywhere in the shop, so Global Fulfillment cannot cover them and those designs are now unbuyable in Canada.
whyGFCannotCoverThem: CLAUDE.md records that none of the kids, tank, women's tee or crop blanks have Global Fulfillment eligible colours, and hoodies, varsity tees and hats are not GF blanks either. Only 6 of Printify's ~1,275 Choice blueprints had eligible colours. So for these garments a local Canadian printer is the only way to avoid import shipping, which is what the -ca listings were for.

US.note: 489 US listings plus 4 -uk listings that should not be there

CA.note: everything in Canada is now printed locally

AU.note: everything in Australia is printed locally

alsoFound: 4 -uk listings are in the US catalog, so a US buyer can reach a UK-printed product. Small, and not related to the cleanup, but worth removing.
intDeletions: 28 of the 98 -int listings were also deleted. Where both the -int and the -ca for a design went, Canada lost it entirely; that is part of the 56 above.
decision: Whether to rebuild the 56 is a judgement about whether those designs are worth selling in Canada at all, not a correctness fix. The committed reports hold every source product, printer, variant count and colour loss, so a rebuild is a rerun.
